% Core PGFPlots line patch vertex order: A -> B.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usepgfplotslibrary{patchplots}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    view={45}{30},
    width=7cm,
    height=5cm,
    xmin=0,xmax=2,
    ymin=0,ymax=2,
    zmin=0,zmax=2,
    xlabel=$x$,
    ylabel=$y$,
    zlabel=$z$
  ]
    \addplot3[patch,patch type=line,line width=1.2pt]
      coordinates {(0,0,0) (2,2,2)};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
